level2.title: Take Up Your Cross
level2.story: On the way to the villages of Caesarea Philippi, Jesus asked, "Whom do men say that I am?" They said John the Baptist, Elijah, or one of the prophets. He asked, "But whom do you say that I am?" Peter answered, "Thou art the Christ." Jesus taught that He must suffer, die, and rise again, and He said, "If any man will follow Me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow Me."
level2.keyLine: Whom do you say that I am? Thou art the Christ.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: What does taking up your cross look like?
level2.prayer: Jesus, You are the Christ; I will follow You. Amen.
